config.record_grain: One ACNC Charity Register row per charity, containing charity identity, business-address components, ACNC registration and establishment dates, reporting attributes, and wide operating-region, subtype, and beneficiary indicators.

fields.evidence: ACNC user guide PDF p. 2 §6: “This is a charity’s Australian Business Number (ABN).” Header ABN; supplied sample 97830467530.
ACNC user guide PDF p. 2 §§8–9: formal name appearing on legal or official documents, pre-populated from legal name. Header Charity_Legal_Name; sample “The Dale Family Foundation”.
Header Address_Type; supplied samples show “Business”. Ontology defines this address category; ACNC user guide PDF p. 2 §§12–14 describes the charity business address.
ACNC user guide PDF p. 2 §§12–14 lists Address line 1 as a business-address field. Header Address_Line_1; sample “L 15 216 St Georges Tce”.
ACNC user guide PDF p. 2 §§12–14 lists Address line 2 as a business-address field. Header Address_Line_2; supplied sample blank.
ACNC user guide PDF p. 2 §§12–14 lists Address line 3 as a business-address field and notes it is blank for many charities. Header Address_Line_3; supplied sample blank.
ACNC user guide PDF p. 2 §§13–14 lists Town/City among business-address fields. Header Town_City; sample “Perth”.
ACNC user guide PDF p. 2 §§13–14 lists State among business-address fields. Header State; sample “WA”.
ACNC user guide PDF p. 2 §§13–14 lists Postcode among business-address fields. Header Postcode; sample “6000”.
ACNC user guide PDF p. 2 §§13–14 lists Country among business-address fields. Header Country; sample “Australia”.

ACNC user guide PDF p. 2 §15: website address where supplied. Header Charity_Website; sample “www.nwrl.org.au”. Supplied validation also encountered “Instagram”, which the website transform quarantines.

ACNC user guide PDF p. 2 §§16–17: effective date of registration with ACNC, with 3 December 2012 for certain pre-ACNC tax-concession charities. Header Registration_Date; sample “13/11/2024”. Kept distinct from company registration.
ACNC user guide PDF p. 3 §18: date the charity was established, which may precede charity registration. Header Date_Organisation_Established; sample “25/06/2024”.
ACNC user guide PDF p. 3 §§19–21: size categories Small, Medium, Large, based on the latest Annual Information Statement. Header Charity_Size; sample “Large”.

ACNC user guide PDF p. 3 §22: number of board or committee members; explicitly says zero means the charity did not supply this information. Header Number_of_Responsible_Persons; sample “2”. Exact source value 0 is excluded to avoid emitting the sentinel as a count.
ACNC user guide PDF p. 3 §§23–24: reported financial year end, which may differ from 30 June. Header Financial_Year_End; sample “30-Jun”.

ACNC user guide PDF p. 4 §§25–26 lists the eight Australian state/territory indicators and says “Y” marks a reported operating region; otherwise blank. Headers Operates_in_ACT through Operates_in_WA; sample Operates_in_VIC “Y”.

values.Preventing_or_relieving_suffering_of_ani: Preventing or relieving suffering of animals
values.Promote_or_oppose_a_change_to_law__gover: Promote or oppose a change to law, government poll or practice
values.Purposes_beneficial_to_ther_general_publ: Purposes beneficial to the general public and other analogous
values.Promoting_reconciliation__mutual_respect: Promoting reconciliation, mutual respect and tolerance
values.Advancing_security_or_safety_of_Australi: Advancing security or safety of Australia or Australian public

fields.evidence: ACNC user guide PDF p. 5 §§29–32 lists the 14 charity subtypes and says a registered subtype is marked “Y”. Headers PBI, HPC, and the named subtype indicators; supplied sample PBI “Y”. Category labels use documented subtype names where header spelling varies.

ACNC user guide PDF p. 6 §§33–34 lists beneficiary categories and says an indicated beneficiary is marked “Y”; otherwise blank. Headers include Aboriginal_or_TSI, Families, animals, environment, other_gender_identities; supplied sample Families “Y”.

unmapped_fields.reason: ACNC user guide PDF p. 2 §§10–11 says values may be one or more trading names or other names, which can differ; the mixed source meaning does not establish every value as a trading name.

Although ACNC user guide PDF p. 4 §§27–28 describes ISO alpha-3 codes for overseas locations, supplied discovery samples show AUS for Australian charity records. The field cannot safely support the ontology's overseas-operating-country claim; leave unmapped rather than emit a misleading AUS claim or infer meaning for other values.

limitations: ACNC registered-charity records are not a comprehensive company register; ACNC registration dates are mapped only to the ACNC-specific registration concept, not entity.date_registered.
Other_Organisation_Names may contain trading names or other names; it is not mapped as a trading name without unambiguous semantics.
The guide says some blanks indicate absent or withheld information; blank indicators are not treated as negative claims.
Number_of_Responsible_Persons value 0 is documented as a non-response sentinel and is excluded; nonzero values are retained as reported counts.
Operating_Countries is left unmapped because observed AUS values conflict with the ontology's overseas operating-location meaning; no country claims are emitted from that column.
The publication timestamp is a source-envelope publication proxy, not a row-level change time. The dataset is updated weekly and withholding can result in omissions or stale appearing records.

The user guide refers to a legacy column sequence; mapping follows the frozen reader headers and supplied header/sample evidence. Supplied validation quarantined some website values such as Instagram as unrecognised website representations.
No company type, entity status, company registration date, or ownership claim is inferred. All authority and field confidence scores are provisional judgements requiring human review.
